messages:
Priya Nair: Quick announcement for teams that work with external vendors — update to invoice processing SLAs and a new early-payment program. Please read & share with your vendors.
Daniel Ortiz: TL;DR? What changed?
Priya Nair: TL;DR: AP now targets Net-30 by default (was Net-45). Were launching an optional early payment discount (1% if paid within 10 days). Also switching invoice uploads to the new AP portal (link below).
Maya Lin: Net-30 for all vendors or just new ones?
Priya Nair: Net-30 applies to all vendors effective next billing cycle. Existing contracts with explicit Net-45 or Net-60 stay unless you renegotiate. If teams want to opt-in vendors for early-pay discounts, add the tag `early-pay` in the upload form.
Anya Sokol: Portal link + required fields?
Priya Nair: Portal: https://ap.redwood.com/upload. Required fields: vendor name, vendor tax ID, invoice number, invoice date, PO number (if applicable), line-item description, amount, approver name. Missing fields will delay processing.
Daniel Ortiz: How about invoices in foreign currency?
Priya Nair: AP supports EUR/GBP/SGD. Please indicate currency on the invoice and upload the vendor bank details. Exchange rates applied on payment date; AP will confirm with submitter if there's a conversion note.
Maya Lin: Early-payment ops: how do teams sign up?
Priya Nair: When uploading, check the `Early Payment Program` box and include the requested discount percentage (default 1%). Finance will calculate cost vs. runway impact and auto-approve for amounts < $20k. Above $20k needs manager + finance sign-off.
Anya Sokol: Disputes or PO mismatches?
Priya Nair: Flag disputes in the portal; AP will mark as `disputed` and notify the budget owner. For PO mismatches, please resolve with supplier and re-upload a corrected invoice or attach a clarification note.
FinanceBot: :bell: Reminder scheduled  "AP portal migration" will ping finance and ops tomorrow at 09:00.
Daniel Ortiz: Any change to invoice numbering conventions?
Priya Nair: Not mandatory but we recommend `VEND-YYYYMM-####` for easier tracking.
Maya Lin: Thanks Priya. We'll notify our vendor ops team and update the vendor handbook.
Priya Nair: Appreciate it. If you need a quick walkthrough for vendor teams, sign up with me. DM if urgent.
